questions.stem: Which of the following is a multiple of both 3 and 5?

questions.stem: Which of the following expressions is guaranteed to be even for all integer values of the variables?
questions.solution: The expression 4m + 2n will always be even because both 4m and 2n are even for any integer values of m and n. Their sum will also be even. questions.stem: If the middle number in a sequence of 5 consecutive even numbers is 5p, what is the third number in the sequence?

The number may or may not be divisible by 12, 16, or 18, depending on its value, but it must be divisible by 36.
